entries.title: G-Police
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows release with modern compatibility fixes

emulation.emulator: Native Windows compatibility fixes; PlayStation Classics emulator for PS4/PS5; DuckStation for owned PS1 copies
emulation.notes: Check known compatibility notes for the Windows version; use the PS4/PS5 classic if convenience matters more than the PC fidelity ceiling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Direct3D release on modern PC, with the PlayStation classic as the official console alternative.

primary.version: Original Windows release with Direct3D acceleration
primary.why: The Windows release is the highest-fidelity base version because it supports Direct3D hardware acceleration and PC display/audio features, while the PS4/PS5 version is an enhanced conversion of the PlayStation release.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original Windows release on a modern PC with community compatibility notes, or choose the PS4/PS5 classic if you prefer the current official console route.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation release, noted for technical ambition but limited draw distance.
all_releases.reason: skip: historically original console release, but the Windows release has the stronger PC fidelity ceiling.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Windows release with Direct3D hardware acceleration and PC feature support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity sourced version thanks to the Windows/Direct3D release path.

all_releases.fidelity: Digital PlayStation classic for PS3/PSP-era PlayStation Store.
all_releases.reason: skip: older digital route for the PlayStation version, superseded by the PS4/PS5 classic for console play.

all_releases.fidelity: Converted PlayStation classic with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
all_releases.reason: skip: best official console route, but it is converted from the PlayStation version rather than the Windows/Direct3D release.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4/PS5 classic is the current official console version with emulator conveniences, but the Windows release remains the higher-fidelity base version because of the PC/Direct3D feature path.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4/PS5 release is an enhanced PlayStation classic conversion, not a remaster of the Windows version.

entries.title: G-Police: Weapons of Justice

emulation.notes: Use DuckStation with an owned copy for modern display options while preserving the PS1 game.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with optional emulator-side improvements.

primary.why: G-Police: Weapons of Justice was released for PlayStation and has no sourced higher-fidelity port or remaster, making the original release the complete version.
primary.how_to_play: Play the original PlayStation disc on compatible hardware, or use DuckStation with an owned copy.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PlayStation sequel with added vehicles, missions, and features over the first game.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and therefore the complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release was identified; the PlayStation release is both the original and complete version.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster or modern official rerelease was identified for Weapons of Justice.
